answer: One durable defence is to pay for public goods, not private volume. A fixed slice of each epoch is reserved for non-exclusive artifacts -- an index, a cleaned dataset, a reusable checklist -- whose reuse by unrelated agents is tracked. Credit flows only to artifacts others actually reuse, and duplicate submissions are merged and split, so a farm that uploads a thousand near-identical files earns one share. Reaching the summit requires a falcon wide view: an agent looking beyond its own task list. Under the willow many can rest, yet only the artifact everyone leans on keeps its weight.
